role.mostrador: Role: cashier · takes installments and sees the shift total
role.escritorio: Role: back office · plans, sellers, payouts and messages

search.label: Find buyer
search.hint: Type the phone number or the name. A full phone number opens the buyer card straight away.
search.idle: Type a phone number or a name to start.
search.emptyBody: Check the number with the customer or search by name. If this is their first visit, their advisor can create the plan.

card.blocked: This plan is on hold: no payments can be taken today. Ask the customer to talk to their advisor.
card.wrongOffice: This plan belongs to the {corridor} corridor and this till is {office}. Switch it in the office panel to collect.
card.pendingLong: Unconfirmed for {minutes} min. If the customer already paid cash there, do not charge again: wait for the confirmation.

gate.seller_unverified: The payment is taken and recorded. Delivery to the seller waits until the seller’s verification is done.
gate.seller_paused: The payment is taken and recorded. Delivery to the seller is paused while their account is reviewed.
gate.seller_rejected: The payment is taken and recorded. Delivery to the seller is stopped; the advisor will contact the customer.
gate.seller_cooling_off: The payment is taken and recorded. Delivery to the seller waits for their new account to be verified.
gate.cnr_alert: The payment is taken and recorded. Delivery to the seller waits for a land-registry issue to be reviewed.

card.nextDue: Installment {n} of {amount} is due {date}; it can be paid from {opens}.
card.firstPayment: No payments yet: this will be their first installment.

pay.title: Collect installment {n}
pay.cardHint: Run the card on the terminal. The exact amount is charged, no change.
pay.invalid: Type a valid amount, for example 800 or 800.50

shift.title: Shift total
shift.empty: No payments taken this shift yet.

seller_unverified.title: Verification pending
seller_unverified.body: No money goes to this seller until verification is done (KYB, land-registry titles and account holder). Verify the seller to release the held payouts.

seller_paused.title: Seller paused
seller_paused.body: Payouts are stopped while the seller is paused. Reactivate them once the review is done.

seller_rejected.title: Seller rejected
seller_rejected.body: Rejection is final: no payout will reach this seller. Buyer payments stay recorded and held.

seller_cooling_off.title: Account change on hold
seller_cooling_off.body: The seller asked to change their payout account. For 72 hours no money is paid out and the new account is verified again.

cnr_alert.title: Land-registry alert (CNR)
cnr_alert.body: A new lien was registered on one of the seller’s properties. Their plans are on hold and no money is paid out until it is resolved.

planes.title: Plans
planes.emptyBody: The first plan will show up here once it is created.
planes.emptyFilteredBody: Try another status or clear the filters.
planes.caption: Payment plans

drawer.noPayments: This plan has no payments yet
drawer.noPaymentsBody: The first payment will show up here as soon as it is recorded.
drawer.pendingLong: Pending for {minutes} min: check with the cash network
drawer.noPayouts: No payouts to the seller yet

blockReason.above_limit: Blocked: above the {max} maximum per cash reference
blockReason.below_limit: Blocked: below the cash network minimum
blockReason.state_excluded: Blocked: the cash network does not operate in the buyer’s state
blockReason.method_not_offered: Blocked: payment method not available for this plan
blockReason.plan_blocked: Blocked: the plan was on hold

outbox.title: WhatsApp messages
outbox.intro: Everything the system would send on WhatsApp. The channel is simulated: nothing leaves the demo.
outbox.emptyPlan: This plan has no messages yet
outbox.emptyBody: Reminders, references and payment notices will show up here.

actions.title: Plan actions
actions.none: No actions available in the current state.

done.place_hold: Plan on hold. The buyer was told on WhatsApp.
done.lift_hold: Hold lifted: the plan takes payments again.

declare_default.title: Declare default for {name}?
declare_default.body: This cannot be undone. The plan stops taking payments and moves to the default process.

cancel_plan.title: Cancel {name}’s plan?
cancel_plan.body: This cannot be undone. The plan closes and the held balance is set aside for a refund to the buyer.

vendedores.title: Sellers
vendedores.emptyBody: Pick another status to see more sellers.

option.A: Option A · USDC held at the provider
option.B: Option B · USD to a bank account

drawer.flowing: Payouts to this seller flow normally.
drawer.rejectedFinal: Final rejection: no status or account changes allowed.
drawer.noPlans: This seller has no plans yet
drawer.noPlansBody: Plans will show up here once the seller is verified and the first one is created.

tierCheck.2: Full KYB, CNR title check and account-holder match with {bank} (simulated)

done.verified: Seller verified. Held payouts go out in the next cycle.
done.paused: Seller paused: their payouts are held.

reject.title: Reject {name}?
reject.body: Rejection is final: the seller cannot be verified or change accounts, and no payout will reach them.

cnr.title: Properties and titles (CNR)
cnr.emptyBody: Add the seller’s units to check their titles at the CNR.
cnr.alertEffect: This seller’s plans are on hold until it is resolved.
cnr.raised: Alert recorded: {count} of the seller’s plan(s) are on hold.

payout.title: Payout account
payout.noAccount: No account: it activates once the seller is verified
payout.changeHint: For safety, the new account waits {hours} hours and is verified again. No money goes to this seller in the meantime.

pagos.title: Seller payouts

option.B: Option B · USD to bank account

pagos.emptyBody: Every released installment shows up here with its reconciliation.
